tools.name: billy_get_organization
tools.description: The Billy company the access token belongs to: id, name, address, registration (CVR) number, base currency, VAT settings, fiscal year, default payment terms, invoice numbering, default accounts. Good first call. GET /organization.

tools.name: billy_list_contacts
tools.description: List customers and suppliers: name, type, address, CVR/registration number, EAN, payment terms, customer/supplier flags. The API has no documented search filter, so `search` is applied to the returned page only (case-insensitive on name, contact number and registration number); page on with next_pag

tools.name: billy_get_contact
tools.description: One contact by id, with its contact persons (names and e-mail addresses). GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: billy_list_invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices and credit notes (newest first by default): number, date, due date, state (draft/approved/voided), amount, tax, balance, isPaid, contactId, currency. Filter by state, customer, number, date, period, paid status or free text. Paged. GET /invoices.

tools.name: billy_get_invoice
tools.description: One invoice by id with its lines (product, description, quantity, unit price, amount, tax) and its payment associations. GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: billy_list_bills
tools.description: List bills (purchase invoices from suppliers): supplier, dates, state (draft/approved/voided), amount, balance, isPaid, supplier invoice number. Filter by state, supplier, dates or paid status. Paged. GET /bills.

tools.name: billy_get_bill
tools.description: One supplier bill by id with its lines. GET /bills/{id}.

tools.name: billy_list_products
tools.description: List products and services usable as invoice lines: name, product number, description, sales account, archived flag. The API has no documented search filter, so `search` is applied to the returned page only (name, productNo). Paged. GET /products.

tools.name: billy_get_product
tools.description: One product by id with its unit prices per currency. GET /products/{id}.

tools.name: billy_list_accounts
tools.description: The chart of accounts: account number, name, group, nature, VAT rate, bank-account flag and bank details (IBAN, bank name) of bank accounts. With is_bank_account=true this lists the bank accounts whose ids billy_list_bank_lines needs. Paged. GET /accounts.

tools.name: billy_list_tax_rates
tools.description: The company's VAT rates: name, rate (as a fraction, 0.25 = 25 percent), whether it applies to sales or purchases, active flag. Paged. GET /taxRates.

tools.name: billy_list_bank_lines
tools.description: List the bank-statement lines of ONE bank account (read only; nothing is matched or reconciled): date, description, amount, side (debit/credit), reconciled flag, receipt state. Get the account id from billy_list_accounts with is_bank_account=true. Paged. GET /bankLines.

tools.name: billy_list_postings
tools.description: List ledger postings (the bookkeeping entries): date, text, account, amount, side (debit/credit), currency, voided flag. Filter by account, date or period. Read only. Paged. GET /postings.

tools.name: billy_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: create ONE new contact (customer and/or supplier) in the company's Billy account. It does not check for duplicates (call billy_list_contacts first) and nothing is sent to the contact. Not idempotent: a repeat call creates a second contact. POST /contacts.

tools.name: billy_create_draft_invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create ONE invoice in the DRAFT state for an existing contact. The invoice is NOT approved, booked, numbered into the ledger or sent: the user reviews it in Billy and approves and sends it there. The invoice number is assigned by Billy. No payment is created. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: billy_create_contact · Private data: billy_get_organization, billy_list_contacts, billy_get_contact, billy_create_contact, billy_create_draft_invoice · Public sink: billy_create_contact, billy_create_draft_invoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: billy_create_contact · Private data: billy_get_organization, billy_list_contacts, billy_get_contact, billy_create_contact, billy_create_draft_invoice · Public sink: billy_create_contact, billy_create_draft_invoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
